notes.title: Update 2.1 Now Live: Introducing Player Choices & UI Enhancements!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm excited to announce a major update for Black Equation – Version 2.1! This patch brings significant enhancements, transforming your journey through Highgard.

Here's what's new in Update 2.1:

Two Distinct Paths, One Epic Saga: The game now features two clearly defined, intertwining narratives:

Part 1: The Analysis of Form – The scientific exploration of the colossal creature has been substantially expanded and deepened, offering new biological secrets to unravel.

Part 2: Echoes from Within – Your epic fantasy adventure is now richer and more complex.

Profound Choices & Dynamic Storytelling: I've added multiple, consequential choices throughout the game! Every decision you make will now directly influence the narrative, reveal unseen events, and shape your story's ending.

Gallery Added: Collect and revisit all the stunning character portraits and haunting character ballads you unlock during your playthroughs. Dive into the art and music anytime!

Achievements Introduced: Challenge yourself to uncover all the secrets and achievements hidden within Highgard's destiny.

Revamped User Interface: Enjoy a refreshed and improved user interface (UI)! The visuals have been enhanced for a smoother, more intuitive, and visually pleasing experience.

macOS & Linux Beta Support: I'm excited to announce the start of beta support for macOS and Linux users (including Steam Deck)! While official testing is ongoing, the game should theoretically be compatible. Please share your experiences in our dedicated Steam Deck Compatibility thread!

Thank you for your continued support and happy adventuring!



Your Solo Indie Developer Alex

notes.title: Version 2.0 – A New Beginning
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I created this project as a way to share a story that lived inside me for years.
At first, I tried to turn it into a game — with numbers, systems, and mechanics. But over time, I realized that none of it felt true to the heart of what I was trying to say.

So with version 2.0, I’ve removed the gameplay. No more resource juggling, no logic puzzles.
Now, it’s exactly what it was always meant to be: a fully linear book in the form of a visual novel.

There are no choices, no branching paths — just the story.
29 chapters, haunting music, and ink illustrations — everything is focused on the world, the emotions, and the characters. Nothing distracts from the heart of it.

If you played the earlier version — thank you.
And if you're just joining — welcome to the story I’ve carried for so long. I hope it speaks to you.

— Alex
